patterns.name: UUID instead of branded ID
patterns.description: Entity creation uses crypto.randomUUID() instead of generating branded IDs matching the type system (F###, P###, S###)
patterns.root_cause: Repositories use generic UUID generation without awareness of branded type conventions
patterns.prevention: Implement sequential ID generation in base repository or ID service
patterns.detection: Check create handlers for crypto.randomUUID() vs branded format
patterns.fix_pattern: Query max(id), parse numeric suffix, increment, format with prefix

patterns.name: State machine duplication
patterns.description: VALID_TRANSITIONS constant duplicated across server and client code (4 locations)
patterns.root_cause: No shared package exports state machine logic, each module defines its own. Also duplicated in test files.
patterns.prevention: Define state machines in @nomos-ai/types and import everywhere
patterns.fix_pattern: Extract to shared package, export as const, import in consumers

patterns.name: DB schema / Zod schema drift
patterns.description: Drizzle table schema missing columns that exist in the corresponding Zod type schema (e.g., project.status, feature.preImplemented)
patterns.root_cause: Zod schemas and Drizzle schemas evolved independently without cross-validation
patterns.prevention: Add build-time check comparing Zod schema keys against Drizzle column names
patterns.detection: Compare exported Zod schema shape with Drizzle table columns
patterns.fix_pattern: Add missing columns + migration, or remove from Zod schema if not needed

patterns.name: TOCTOU in bulk operations
patterns.description: Bulk status update validates then modifies in separate steps without transaction
patterns.root_cause: Validation and mutation not wrapped in same transaction
patterns.prevention: Always use transactions for validate-then-mutate patterns
patterns.detection: Look for await Promise.all() followed by separate update calls

patterns.name: Error handling boilerplate duplication
patterns.description: Identical try-catch error handling pattern repeated 32+ times across all oRPC router handlers
patterns.root_cause: No shared error handling middleware or utility
patterns.prevention: Create withErrorHandling wrapper or oRPC middleware
patterns.fix_pattern: Extract to shared utility function in packages/api/src/utils/

patterns.name: Missing ownership/access control (IDOR)
patterns.description: Entity tables have no userId column — any authenticated user can CRUD any entity. API routers pass context.session.user.id but schema has no column for it.
patterns.prevention: Always include userId column with FK to auth.user table in entity schemas
patterns.detection: Check entity tables for userId/ownerId columns
patterns.fix_pattern: Add userId column, update repository methods to filter by userId, pass from auth context

patterns.name: Missing security headers
patterns.description: Hono server missing X-Frame-Options, CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options headers
patterns.root_cause: Security middleware not configured in server setup
patterns.prevention: Add secureHeaders middleware to all Hono servers
patterns.detection: Check server index.ts for secureHeaders or equivalent middleware

patterns.name: Feature status mismatch (phantom in_progress)
patterns.description: Features marked as in_progress in features.json but zero implementation code exists
patterns.root_cause: Status was updated prematurely before implementation started
patterns.prevention: Only transition to in_progress after initial code is committed
patterns.detection: Cross-reference feature status with git log/file existence
patterns.fix_pattern: Reset status to pending if no implementation files exist

patterns.name: Hardcoded frontend constants
patterns.description: CATEGORIES, PHASES, SIZES, statusColors defined inline in components instead of imported from types
patterns.root_cause: Components developed independently without centralizing shared constants
patterns.prevention: Export all enum values and display metadata from @nomos-ai/types
patterns.detection: Search for inline const arrays matching type enum values
patterns.fix_pattern: Export from types, import in all consuming components

patterns.name: Non-atomic ID generation race condition
patterns.description: getNextId() reads MAX(id), parses, increments, returns — not atomic. Concurrent creates produce duplicate IDs
patterns.root_cause: SELECT MAX + increment pattern without transaction or lock
patterns.prevention: Always wrap read-increment-write in database transaction
patterns.detection: Look for MAX(id) queries followed by non-transactional returns
patterns.fix_pattern: Wrap in db.transaction(), or use sequence table, or use RETURNING with INSERT

patterns.name: Type-unsafe Record<string, unknown> in update handlers
patterns.description: Router update handlers construct dynamic update objects using Record<string, unknown>, losing all Zod type safety
patterns.root_cause: Dynamic object construction without type-aware filtering
patterns.prevention: Use Object.fromEntries with proper typing or typed helper utility
patterns.detection: Search for 'Record<string, unknown>' in router files
patterns.fix_pattern: Replace with: const data = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(input.data).filter(([,v]) => v !== undefined)) as Partial<typeof input.data>

patterns.name: Frontend validation gap (client-server mismatch)
patterns.description: Backend Zod validates constraints (min length, min array count) but frontend forms don't replicate these checks, causing confusing UX on rejection
patterns.root_cause: Frontend form validation implemented independently of backend Zod schemas
patterns.prevention: Share validation schemas between frontend and backend via @nomos-ai/types
patterns.detection: Compare frontend validator rules against backend Zod schema constraints
patterns.fix_pattern: Import Zod schema min/max constraints and apply in frontend validators

patterns.name: Stale component state on panel/modal close
patterns.description: Edit state persists when UI panel closed via click-outside instead of explicit Cancel button
patterns.root_cause: onOpenChange handler does not reset local edit state like the Cancel handler does
patterns.prevention: Always add useEffect cleanup that resets edit state when open prop changes to false
patterns.detection: Search for isEditing/editState with onOpenChange without corresponding cleanup

patterns.name: Rate limiter memory leak (unbounded Map)
patterns.description: In-memory rate limiter stores IP entries but never removes expired ones, growing unbounded
patterns.root_cause: Map.set() called for new entries but Map.delete() never called for expired entries
patterns.prevention: Always implement TTL cleanup for in-memory caches
patterns.detection: Search for Map-based stores without setInterval cleanup
patterns.fix_pattern: setInterval(() => { for (const [k, v] of map) { if (expired(v)) map.delete(k); } }, 60000)

patterns.name: SDK safety flag missing for bypassPermissions
patterns.description: Claude Agent SDK requires allowDangerouslySkipPermissions: true when using permissionMode: 'bypassPermissions', but flag was omitted
patterns.root_cause: SDK contract not fully read — safety flag documented in type declarations but not in primary docs
patterns.prevention: Always check SDK type declarations (sdk.d.ts) for required companion flags when using non-default modes

patterns.name: Incomplete SDK enum coverage
patterns.description: Local constant defining SDK enum values missing newer modes (delegate, dontAsk) that SDK supports
patterns.root_cause: SDK enum values copied manually instead of imported or derived from SDK types
patterns.prevention: Import types directly from SDK where possible, or derive local types from const objects
patterns.detection: Compare local enum/const values against SDK type declarations
patterns.fix_pattern: Use SDK's exported type or keep local const synced with SDK and derive type via typeof
